thread:
olivia: After the runtime inference outage postmortem I uploaded, we need to assign remediation owners and update runbooks/playbooks. Short summary: KV-cache fallback wasn't triggered, autoscaler scaled down too aggressively, and escalation steps were ambiguous. Please ack and claim owners.

sam: Ack. I'll own autoscaler safe defaults + rollout plan for Dedicated & Hosted. Will open a PR. :thumbsup:

maya: I can own the KV-cache fallback detection and add a healthcheck probe. Adding these triage snippets to the runbook:
```
# check runtime pods and restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference-runtime -o wide
kubectl describe pod <pod> -n inference
kubectl logs -n inference <pod> --tail=200
sudo journalctl -u inference-runtime -n 500
```

dinesh: I'll draft an explicit escalation playbook fragment. Proposal: 0-2m on-call tries restart & checks logs; 2-10m page infra lead + runtime SME; 10m+ page SRE manager & execs if SLA impacted. Will add contact matrix.

tomas: I'll own monitoring changes: add a kvcache-fallback metric and a synthetic hitting prefix cache. Also suggest an alert when fallback hasn't been used for X minutes.

ops-bot: Created INF-4210 in backlog for runbook/playbook edits. https://redwood/issue/INF-4210

olivia: We need timelines. Target close within 2 weeks unless blocked. Owners, please add ETAs.

sam: Autoscaler PR on infra/safer-autoscale. ETA 5 business days. Will include canary plan and rollback window.

maya: Runbook edits + KV checks, ETA 7 business days. I'll include triage steps and detection guidance.

dinesh: Escalation playbook PR to docs/playbooks/runtime-escalation, ETA 3 business days. Includes pager rotation and who-to-page rules.

tomas: Monitoring alert + synthetic, ETA 6 business days. Will add a staging canary for 1h test.

olivia: Action summary (for search): - INF-4210: Runbook & playbook edits (maya) — due +7d; - INF-4211: Autoscaler safe defaults + canary (sam) — due +5d; - INF-4212: Escalation playbook + contact matrix (dinesh) — due +3d; - INF-4213: Monitoring/alerts + synthetic test (tomas) — due +6d.

maya: @olivia please add INF numbers to the postmortem action table; I'll link PRs when ready.

olivia: Done. I've scheduled weekly follow-up check-ins for 3 weeks to monitor recurring patterns and close items. Invitees: @sam @maya @dinesh @tomas @oncall.

tomas: Request: add an on-call drill section to playbook—simulate pod eviction, verify fallback, confirm alerts.

dinesh: I'll add a runbook exercise with expected outputs.

sam: Noted. Also instituting a 48h change freeze on related infra configs post-merge as a safety buffer.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up check-ins scheduled for upcoming Mondays starting <2026-03-30>.

olivia: Thanks all. If blocked (permissions, quotas, cross-team owners), reply here and we'll escalate. Closing thread for day-to-day noise; will reopen on PR updates. :eyes:
